instruction: Cinematic medium shot on a sunny riverfront with a bridge behind. On the left, the blonde woman in the orange floral top (R1) faces right, smiling warmly and reaching her arms out. On the right, the dark-haired woman in the white knit tank top (R2) faces her, stepping forward to embrace. In the bottom right corner, the top of a bystander's head is partially visible. Bright, warm daylight fills the frame.
